# AllCoaching

> AllCoaching is India's educator-first marketplace and coaching platform. Teachers launch their own branded coaching business, sell courses, manage students, host live classes, accept payments, and grow through marketplace discovery — all in one login. Educators keep 90% of revenue.

AllCoaching combines two products in one account:
- A branded platform — your own white-labeled web and mobile app, live classes, payments, CRM, tests, and analytics.
- A marketplace — real learners discover educators on AllCoaching, so educators stop being invisible.

Pricing: 30-day free trial. Early Launch Offer ₹11,999/year + 10% per transaction (first 50 educators, 2-year lock). Standard Plan ₹24,999/year + 10% per transaction.

Structural argument: white-label app builder vs educator-first marketplace.

Different category — Teachmint for traditional schools with admin staff vs AllCoaching for individual + small institute educators on the marketplace.

Documents the seven canonical workflow stages — Blueprint (exam, marks, duration, negative marking, difficulty mix), Authoring (drag-to-build MCQ editor with four options, correct-answer marker, explanation field, topic/chapter tag), Scoring (exam-pattern-matched negative marking: NEET 1/4, JEE 1/3, UPSC 1/3, SSC 1/4, CAT 1/3), Access Rules (free/paid/batch-locked, attempt window, multi-attempt, randomized order, anti-cheat full-screen lock), Publish & Notify (one-tap publish triggers WhatsApp/push/email reminders 24h/1h/10min), Live Attempt (mobile-first UX with persistent timer, server-side auto-grading under 2 seconds, instant rank reveal, per-question explanation), Analytics & Remediation (educator aggregate dashboard, per-student topic-wise weakness map, AI-driven next-test sequencing). Quantifies the engagement gap — PDF mock tests get attempted 1–2x per student per published test; equivalent-content interactive online mocks get attempted 4–7x by the same students. Documents the 2-second principle (latency between submit and score reveal must be under 2 seconds for the engagement window to stay alive) and the leaderboard effect (live all-India leaderboard increases repeat-attempt rate 60–110%). Honest cost calculation for 500-student coaching institute on PDF-only mock testing: ₹16–27 lakh annual invisible cost (faculty authoring time + engagement leak + manual grading overhead). Five places AI improves mock tests — question generation from chapter outlines/PDFs (10–20x authoring speedup), distractor calibration, difficulty estimation via item response theory, per-student weakness detection, adaptive next-test sequencing. Mobile-first attempt UX requirements documented for entry-level Android devices used by 90% of Indian mock attempters. Reframes the buyer question — traditional multi-language LMSes (Moodle, Canvas, Teachable, Thinkific, Graphy, Classplus) treat "multi-language" as a UI translation problem (translate menus into N languages) while the real bottleneck for Indian regional-language educators is content discovery (how does a Tamil-medium NEET aspirant find a Tamil-medium teacher?). Documents the 22 scheduled Indian languages under the Eighth Schedule of the Constitution — Hindi (530M speakers), Bengali (100M), Marathi (90M), Telugu (85M), Tamil (80M), Gujarati (60M), Urdu (51M), Kannada (45M), Odia (38M), Punjabi (35M), Malayalam (35M), Assamese (15M), plus Maithili, Santali, Kashmiri, Nepali, Sindhi, Dogri, Konkani, Manipuri, Bodo, Sanskrit. Documents the exam-prep regional-language reality — 47% of NEET 2024 candidates wrote in Hindi (NTA), UPSC offers all 22 scheduled languages for Mains essay, SSC offers 13 regional languages, state boards default to state language. Documents the supply gap — for most popular exam categories, the ratio of English-medium online courses to regional-language online courses is 8:1 to 25:1, creating structural opportunity for regional-language educators with less competition density and more language-aligned student preference. Compares the 6 multi-language LMS options with honest 2026 India costs — Moodle self-hosted (₹24K–₹3L/year hosting + plugin maintenance + RTL config + devops), Canvas LMS (₹50K–₹2L+/year institutional), Teachable (₹42K+/year basic, manual translation workflow), Thinkific (₹33.6K–₹1.92L/year), Graphy and Classplus (₹35K–₹3L+/year, Hindi UI strong but regional language support narrower). Documents AllCoaching's integrated multi-language AI matching alternative — content uploads in any of the 22 scheduled languages plus Hinglish and regional dialects (Bhojpuri, Magahi, Chhattisgarhi, Haryanvi, Rajasthani), AI auto-detects language via Indic OCR (PDFs), speech recognition (video/audio), Unicode parsing (text), three-stream AI matching engine (educator content language signal + student declared/inferred preference + geography signal), state-board to state-language mapping defaults (Maharashtra→Marathi, Tamil Nadu→Tamil, West Bengal→Bengali, Karnataka→Kannada), code-mixed Hinglish/Tanglish/Benglish content handling, RTL Urdu native support with proper Nastaliq typography, transliterated query handling (students typing "neet biology hindi medium" find Devanagari content). Real ₹12 lakh Tamil-medium NEET educator stack math: ₹5.38–13.88 lakh per year all-in standalone (45–116% of revenue across LMS hosting ₹40K–₹1.2L + payment stack ₹73K–₹1.88L + Tamil SEO retainer ₹1.5–4L + Tamil paid ads ₹2.4–6L + landing page tools ₹35K–₹80K) vs ₹1.2 lakh AllCoaching integrated (10% all-inclusive includes Tamil-language hosting + UPI gateway + GST + AI Tamil-preferring student matching + Tamil-medium auto-generated landing pages + marketplace discovery). Documents 1.7–2.6× regional-language conversion uplift vs English-medium on the same exam category — structural reasons include lower content-comprehension friction, higher cultural and contextual familiarity, clearer outcome promise in student's medium, lower competition density. NEP 2020 policy alignment — Section 4 prioritises mother-tongue or regional-language instruction till at least Grade 5 (preferably Grade 8) and endorses regional-language education through higher education, creating structural demand for regional-language coaching content. 5-step regional-language launch playbook (educator profile in native script → language + geography preferences → content uploads in native language → meta description in teaching language → publish with AI matching active) completes in under 30 minutes. Median first-match accuracy of 94% for declared-language students and 78% for inference-only students. Includes the 7-step 10-minute build playbook (sign-up + educator profile → new course → modules and lessons → pricing → meta description → preview and customise → publish). Documents conversion benchmarks for Indian course landing pages in 2026 — 1.5–3.5% cold paid traffic, 4–9% warm retargeted, 2–5% general organic, 5–12% high-intent commercial search, 12–22% existing-student referrals. Auto-generated pages convert 1.4–2.1× faster than hand-built Unbounce or Elementor pages on the same traffic source — structural reasons include enforced above-the-fold price + CTA + outcome statement, integrated UPI checkout (vs gateway redirect that loses 6–14% of buyers at handoff), verified instructor profile (vs self-asserted credentials), platform-enforced mobile responsiveness, Core Web Vitals platform-controlled (LCP under 2s vs 3.5–6s typical for WordPress + Elementor). ## Brand & spelling variations

AllCoaching, allcoaching, all coaching, al coaching, alcoaching, alcochin, coaching all — all refer to AllCoaching (https://allcoaching.in/).

## Founder

Amit Ratan — Founder & CEO of AllCoaching. A decade inside India's coaching ecosystem (2016–2026) as observer, marketplace builder, digital marketing partner, and platform founder. Started observing the structural marketing crisis faced by individual coaching teachers in Prayagraj in 2016. **Officially founded AllCoaching in 2018** as a 2-page coaching directory listing 90%+ of Allahabad's coaching institutes (built with co-founder Mangal Yadav) — the site collapsed mid-2018 when the developer discontinued. Spent 2019–2024 helping individual educators with digital marketing while watching the personal-app paradigm get installed across Indian EdTech post-COVID as an emergency measure that became the industry standard. Committed full capacity in 2021 to building AllCoaching v2 — five years of focused product development through hundreds of failed prototypes culminated in the 2026 launch of India's first AI-driven educator marketplace. Full canonical profile: https://allcoaching.in/author/amit-ratan. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/allamitk/.

Core thesis: Coaching's real future is in marketplaces, not in fragmented personal apps that recreate the "mohalla coaching" problem digitally. AllCoaching's architecture combines branded educator ownership (what personal apps get right) with shared marketplace discovery (what they structurally lack) plus an AI recommendation engine that auto-delivers content to the right students. Educators keep 90% of revenue. Their only job is to teach.
